items.name: file-viewer
items.title: File Viewer
items.description: A full-screen dark overlay for stored files — images with a blur-up, zoom and pan; PDFs rendered page by page with a lazily loaded pdf.js over range requests; video and audio in the system players; the first megabyte of text, CSV (a table) and Markdown; Excel workbooks (sheet tabs, the first 500 rows) and Word documents, read by lazily loaded SheetJS and mammoth; app-parsed previews through loadPreview; a file card with a thumbnail and Download for everything else — paged with arrows, side buttons or a swipe — as a full-screen overlay, a side sheet for reading beside a chat, or in place as a file's page; a preview that can't load says why with Retry and Download; with Share/Watch/menu header slots and a Details · Comments · Activity rail (a bottom sheet on a phone).

meta.whenToUse: Opening stored files full screen from attachment tiles, a product's files or a gallery — images to zoom, PDFs to read, video and audio to play, text, CSV, Markdown, Excel and Word files to read, other Office files as a card (or the app's own parsed preview through loadPreview).
meta.whenNotToUse: An inline player on a page (VideoPlayer, AudioPlayer), or a general-purpose modal (Dialog).

items.name: folder-tree
items.title: Folder Tree
items.description: A Notion-style navigation tree for a file library — sections of folders, pages and files; folders that load their children on first open with loading, error, empty and Show all rows; one tab stop with tree arrow keys and typeahead; a ⋯ menu per row; pointer drag into a folder or section; and a folders-only picker mode for Move dialogs.

meta.whenToUse: The navigation pane of a file library or knowledge base — folders, pages and files in sections, with lazy folders, row menus and drag to move; and, in picker mode, the folder list of a Move dialog.
meta.whenNotToUse: App navigation with fixed links (Sidebar), a flat list of files (AttachmentGroup layout="list" or DataList), or a nested filter editor (FilterBuilder).

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: The “On this page” outline of a long document — links to its headings with the one the reader has reached marked by a scroll spy; an always-labelled list, a rail of ticks that opens on hover or focus, or a left Sheet from a trigger on narrow screens. Exports useActiveHeading for custom outlines.

meta.whenToUse: Headings of a long document (TextEdit onOutlineChange, MarkdownView headingIds) as an “On this page” list or rail, with a trigger instance in the header below the rail's breakpoint.
meta.whenNotToUse: App navigation between pages (Sidebar, NavigationMenu, Breadcrumb), or a folder hierarchy (FolderTree).

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: A presentational framed image with aspect-ratio, rounding, a loading skeleton, and an error fallback.

meta.whenToUse: Display a resolved image URL with reserved aspect-ratio, a loading skeleton, and a graceful error fallback.
meta.whenNotToUse: When you must fetch/resolve the source (R2/CDN keys) — presentational; resolve URLs app-side.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A styled Base UI input for every text-entry type — Field-aware state, invalid and disabled chrome, and the background focus tint with a border that never moves (FOC-14).

meta.whenToUse: Single-line text entry — email, password, search, URL/slug with a domain prefix, numbers, etc.
meta.whenNotToUse: Multi-line text (use a textarea) or choosing from fixed options (use a select/radio).

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input or textarea with addons — icons, text, buttons, kbd hints, spinners and dropdowns, aligned inline or block, sharing one bordered surface.

meta.whenToUse: A text control that needs an affordance on the same surface — a search icon, a currency prefix, a reveal button, a character counter.
meta.whenNotToUse: A control whose affordance belongs outside the field — use a Field description or a ButtonGroup.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time-password field with per-character slots — copy/paste aware, patterned, separable, and driven by one hidden input.

meta.whenToUse: Entering a short verification code — 2FA, email confirmation, a device-pairing PIN.
meta.whenNotToUse: Any value longer than a handful of characters, or one the user may not know the length of — use an Input.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A composable row for list and feed content — media, title, description, actions — with a highlighted flash for a just-changed row.

meta.whenToUse: A row of structured content in a feed, list, or panel — a person, file, notification, or settings link — with optional media and trailing actions. Rows rendered as links or buttons can sit inside an ItemGroup (the list item moves to a wrapper), and ItemGroupLabel names a group.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular/sortable data with columns (use Table or DataList) or a zero-data placeholder (use Empty).

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard-key chip, and a group that lays several of them out inline.

meta.whenToUse: Display a keyboard shortcut or key in menus, tooltips, command palettes, help text.
meta.whenNotToUse: As an interactive control or to capture keystrokes — Kbd is presentational only.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A styled native label for form controls.

meta.whenToUse: Label any form control — pair via htmlFor/id or by wrapping. Mark a mandatory field on the control itself (required, aria-required) and say so in the label text.
meta.whenNotToUse: As a heading, or when you need a full field layout — use Field.

items.name: inline-chip
items.title: Inline Chip
items.description: The one inline reference in running text — a person, page, file, task, meeting, customer, project, product or family — on the text's baseline at its size, a person in blue and every record neutral with its kind's icon; a person previews avatar, name and email on hover, the rest open on click with ⌘-click for a new tab.

meta.whenToUse: A mention or a file link inside text — an editor, a Markdown body, a comment — that should read as part of the sentence and open or preview its target.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record's property value or a picker (RecordChip), a removable token in an input (Chip), or a status label (Badge).

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: Markdown View
items.description: Render a markdown string to safe, token-styled HTML — headings (with optional ids and copy links), lists, code, blockquotes, links, GFM tables that fade at a scrolling edge, mention and file chips, callouts and toggles — XSS-safe, no raw HTML; at the document type scale it is a page's read view with comment highlights, an outline, per-reader toggles and find.

meta.whenToUse: Display user/system-authored markdown — descriptions, comments, activity — as safe token-styled prose.
meta.whenNotToUse: Editing markdown (use an editor), or when the source needs embedded raw HTML.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: An inline conversation marker - status lines, system notes, and labelled dividers. 3 variants, Base UI render-polymorphic.

meta.whenToUse: Annotate a thread inline - a merged/status line, a date divider, or a small action row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A standalone status chip outside a conversation (use Badge) or a full banner (use Alert).

items.name: media-player-controls
items.title: Media Player Controls
items.description: The shared media transport — play/pause, seek, elapsed/duration, mute + volume, playback speed, and one keyboard shortcut map — composed by Audio Player and Video Player.

meta.whenToUse: You are building a player around your own <audio>/<video> element and want the VegaStack transport, chrome and keyboard map.
meta.whenNotToUse: A ready-made player — reach for Audio Player or Video Player, which compose this.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A persistent horizontal bar of menus — application-style File / Edit / View navigation.

meta.whenToUse: A desktop-application shell where several menus stay visible and move focus between each other. A two-line row composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the row's accessible description — including a disabled row's reason.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single button's actions (DropdownMenu), or site navigation (NavigationMenu).

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Layout primitives for a conversation row - avatar anchoring, content column, header/footer slots, start/end alignment. Server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Lay out a chat/AI conversation row - compose Avatar, Bubble, and Marker as children.
meta.whenNotToUse: A non-conversational list row - use a plain layout or Data List / Settings Row.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: An auto-scrolling conversation viewport (not virtualised) - pins to the latest message, preserves position on prepend, tracks the anchor, and a floating scroll-to-end button.

meta.whenToUse: A live chat/AI thread that must auto-scroll, keep its place when older messages load, and offer a jump-to-latest control.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short, static list that fits without scrolling - use Message inside a plain container or Scroll Area.

items.name: use-stick-to-bottom
items.title: useStickToBottom
items.description: Keeps a chat thread on its newest line while the reader is there, lets go when they scroll up, and comes back when they reach the bottom or send.

meta.whenToUse: A MessageScroller thread whose answers stream: pass the reader's newest message id as follow, and keep the engine's autoScroll off.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list that never grows while read, or a feed that should hold its place (a log the reader pages through).

items.name: transcript
items.title: Transcript
items.description: A timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript on MessageScroller's primitive - turns with a coloured speaker dot, the line playing at currentTime followed with a Back to current line button, seek from each timestamp, highlighted announced search, renaming a speaker from any turn, and progressive mounting of long transcripts.

meta.whenToUse: The text of a recording - a meeting, call or interview - read alongside its player: timestamped speaker lines that follow playback, seek on click, and can be searched.
meta.whenNotToUse: A live chat or AI thread that pins to the newest message (MessageScroller with Message), or a chronological record of events rather than speech (ActivityFeed).

items.name: meta-line
items.title: Meta Line
items.description: An icon + text meta line under a record title: wrapping facts such as type, date and time, duration and owner, in the muted ink.

meta.whenToUse: The facts line under a record's title — type, date and time, duration, who recorded it.
meta.whenNotToUse: Labelled key/value details (PropertyList) or status (Badge, StatusLine).

items.name: entry-list
items.title: Entry List
items.description: A short, compact list of plain entries in a sheet, dialog or popover: a line of text, its muted details and small actions at its end.

meta.whenToUse: A handful of plain lines inside a panel — what changed, who was asked, the edits since a date — with their details and small actions.
meta.whenNotToUse: Rows that are targets themselves (Item), records with columns (DataList), facts under a title (MetaLine).

items.name: value-change
items.title: Value Change
items.description: An inline before → after diff of one value: the old value struck in a del, a muted arrow, the new value in an ins, with a spoken "changed from A to B".

meta.whenToUse: One field's old and new value in an activity feed, audit log, impact review or version note.
meta.whenNotToUse: Comparing whole texts or documents (DiffView), or a number's trend (Stat).

items.name: file-card
items.title: File Card
items.description: One file as a card row: thumbnail or type icon, name, description lines and a ⋯ actions menu. A file opens the viewer, an href makes the whole card a link (a download, or a page elsewhere); UploadCard is the same row for a file uploading, with progress, Retry and Cancel.

meta.whenToUse: A record's or task's files as a list or grid of cards (put them in AttachmentGroup layout="cards" or list): a thumbnail or type icon, name, size and who/when, a ⋯ menu, opening the viewer or linking to a download or page; UploadCard for the files still uploading.
meta.whenNotToUse: A square tile grid or a scrolling strip (compose Attachment with orientation="vertical"), or a single inline chip in chat.

items.name: record-chip
items.title: Record Chip
items.description: A pill that shows the record something belongs to and picks another: icon, name and a chevron as a picker trigger, plus an arrow link to the record — or, as the ghost variant, a property value that reads as plain text.

meta.whenToUse: Linking a record to another one in its header — a meeting's customer or project — with a picker and a jump to the linked record.
meta.whenNotToUse: A free-form tag (Chip) or a form field with a label (Combobox, Select).

items.name: block-toolbar
items.title: Block Toolbar
items.description: The one place a block's own controls sit: its top-right corner, 28px icon buttons named and tipped by their labels, at most four and a ⋯ menu for the rest, always shown or revealed on the block's hover and focus.

meta.whenToUse: A block in a document with controls of its own — a code block's copy, an image's caption and alt text, a diagram's expand — so every block's chrome sits in the same corner at the same size.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page's or a panel's toolbar (a header row of actions), or a selection's formatting (TextEdit's bubble).

items.name: task-inline
items.title: Task Inline
items.description: A task in running text — one round box (its done state), the title that opens its peek, the assignee's avatar, a due chip and ↗ to its page on hover — plus MakeTaskPopover, which makes that task from a checklist line in place, with the host's assignee, due and space pickers in slots.

meta.whenToUse: A checklist line linked to a task, or a task named in running text, where the reader ticks it, opens it and sees who and when; MakeTaskPopover to make one from a line.
meta.whenNotToUse: A task row in a list or board (DataList, BoardCard) or a plain reference to a task in a sentence (InlineChip).

items.name: record-list
items.title: Record List
items.description: A numbered list of the records a change affects — a muted record-type icon, the name with a new-tab link after it, a badge and a description line — plus a Show more footer whose next rows keep the numbering. For confirmation dialogs.

meta.whenToUse: The records a change will touch, listed in a confirmation dialog (the products a save affects, the products a delete leaves), each with a link to open it in a new tab.
meta.whenNotToUse: Navigable or selectable lists (Item, DataList), pickers (Combobox), or a single linked record (RecordChip).

items.name: status-line
items.title: Status Line
items.description: A slim inline status: info, progress (spinner) or error (destructive ink, role=alert), with an optional inline action.

meta.whenToUse: One line of status inside a record header — processing, a failure with its reason and Retry, a quiet notice.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page-level message with a title (Alert) or a transient confirmation (Toast).

items.name: use-tabs-swipe
items.title: useTabsSwipe
items.description: Switch controlled Tabs with a horizontal touch swipe on the panel area; vertical gestures stay a scroll and the direction follows RTL.

meta.whenToUse: Tabs over full-width panels on a phone, where a swipe between Summary / Action items / Transcript is expected.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabs whose panels scroll horizontally themselves (tables, carousels) — the gesture would fight them.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The platform <select>, tokenized — the OS picker on mobile, option groups, and the same chrome as every other field.

meta.whenToUse: A short list of plain options where the platform picker is the better experience — mobile forms, dense tables, settings rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Options that need icons, descriptions or custom markup, or a list long enough to want search — use Select or Combobox.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site-nav mega-dropdown on the Base UI NavigationMenu primitive — chip triggers, one shared sliding panel, grid links.

meta.whenToUse: Top-level site/product navigation with rich dropdown panels.
meta.whenNotToUse: In-app action menus (DropdownMenu) or content tabs (Tabs).

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: The notification Inbox: frame with header actions, For you · Updates · Archived tabs, sticky day groups, full-bleed rows grouped per record (stacked actors, a count that expands to the events), inline Allow / Decline or an answered line, J / K triage driving a peek, a fixed right column with the time over the hover actions (read toggle and menu), and empty, loading and error states.

meta.whenToUse: The notifications panel: a feed of person and system events the user reads, acts on and marks read. Put it in a Sheet, Popover or docked panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Toasts for transient confirmations, an activity log on a record (ActivityFeed), or a bare unread marker (NotificationDot).

items.name: notification-dot
items.title: Notification Dot
items.description: The one unread dot: an 8px solid circle, decorative, for unread rows, inbox items and nav items.

meta.whenToUse: Marking something unread — a row in a list, an inbox item, a nav or rail item. The row says "unread" in its own accessible name.
meta.whenNotToUse: A count (use Badge) or a status (use StatusIcon).

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: Locale-aware numeric input on Base UI's NumberField in upstream's InputGroup chrome, with full-height flanking steppers.

meta.whenToUse: Any numeric value — quantities, limits, percentages, money (format={{ style: 'currency', currency }}) — where parsing, locale formatting, and stepping should be correct by construction.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-text that merely contains digits (phone numbers, postal codes, ids) — formatting/stepping semantics would fight the value; use Input.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The standardized header at the top of a page — back button, breadcrumb trail, title, description, actions and secondary menu — plus SectionHeading for in-page section titles (sm and md sizes, a muted eyebrow variant, trailing actions).

meta.whenToUse: The header band at the top of a page — title plus back/breadcrumb nav (backRender for a framework link), actions, favorite, and a meta row that can hold badges and inline pickers.
meta.whenNotToUse: App-shell chrome (top nav/sidebar) or a section heading inside a page.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation — previous/next, numbered page links, an ellipsis for long ranges, and the active page.

meta.whenToUse: Navigate paged content with real URLs — a long list/table split across numbered pages; every page control is a link.
meta.whenNotToUse: Infinite scroll / 'load more' feeds, or tab-style switching.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An anchored, dismissible surface for secondary content, with a header, title and description.

meta.whenToUse: Rich, interactive content anchored to a control — a small form, a picker, a details card.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short label (Tooltip), a list of actions (DropdownMenu), or anything that must block the page (Dialog).

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A horizontal progress bar for measurable, ongoing tasks — determinate or a sweeping indeterminate segment, built on Base UI Progress.

meta.whenToUse: Completion of a measurable task — uploads, multi-step forms, onboarding.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indefinite waits (Spinner) or radial percentage display (out of scope).

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A guided one-question-at-a-time form — choices, freeform answers, skip, shortcuts, validation, resume and conditional items, built on the @shadcn/react questionnaire state machine.

meta.whenToUse: An onboarding, survey or intake flow that asks one question at a time, validates each answer, and can be resumed.
meta.whenNotToUse: A conventional form where every field is visible at once — compose Field with the form primitives instead.

items.name: property-list
items.title: Property List
items.description: Record-facts rows: an icon+label column beside a value column, as an accessible definition list.

meta.whenToUse: Heterogeneous key→value panes (record details, metadata sidebars).
meta.whenNotToUse: Homogeneous collections (DataList/Table) or form editing (Field).

items.name: members-stack
items.title: Members Stack
items.description: Who has access, drawn one way everywhere: 24px faces overlapped 6px, at most three and a "+N" pill of the same height, active people first; only you, everyone in a space and a team as their own forms; names on hover and one members popover.

meta.whenToUse: Show who has access to or is in a place: the page bar's members slot, a space or record header, the Share button, a list row's Members cell (with count).
meta.whenNotToUse: A picker of people (PeoplePicker) or a full member list (DataList).

items.name: person-hover-card
items.title: Person Hover Card
items.description: A person behind an avatar or a name: hover, focus or tap opens a compact card with a 32px avatar, the name and a muted email.

meta.whenToUse: Preview a person behind their avatar or name (a comment's author, an activity's actor, a participant). Stacks of people are MembersStack.
meta.whenNotToUse: A picker of people (SearchableSelect) or a full member list (DataList).

items.name: people-picker
items.title: People Picker
items.description: The one picker for people and teams — a field (single or multiple), a popover body for a host trigger, or a dropdown submenu — with avatar rows, "(you)", team sizes, skeleton loading, footer actions and active people only.

meta.whenToUse: Choose a person (assignee, owner, manager) or several people and teams (members of a team or space, a share invite), or filter by person — every people picker.
meta.whenNotToUse: Type free-form tokens such as emails (ChipInput), or pick non-person records (SearchableSelect).

items.name: record-picker
items.title: Record Picker
items.description: Pick records of the kinds the app passes in — search, kind filter, recents, folder browsing, refused rows — in a popover or a dialog.

meta.whenToUse: Linking, relating, attaching or inserting records of several kinds: a relation field, a mention target, a block source, a Link to… dialog, an Add from… dialog that browses folders.
meta.whenNotToUse: A fixed option list (Select, SearchableSelect), people (PeoplePicker) or a place to move something (DestinationPicker).

items.name: destination-picker
items.title: Destination Picker
items.description: Choose where something goes — spaces, their folders, recents, search, refusals with a reason.

meta.whenToUse: A Move to… dialog: moving a page, file, folder, table, task or meeting into a space or folder.
meta.whenNotToUse: Picking a record to link (RecordPicker) or a space alone (SpacePicker).

items.name: field-type-picker
items.title: Field Type Picker
items.description: A searchable, grouped list of field types with icons, and an optional second step.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing a field type: + Add field on a table, a form builder, a field settings Type row.
meta.whenNotToUse: Any other fixed list (Select) or record list (RecordPicker).

items.name: permission-menu
items.title: Permission Menu
items.description: An access level on a sharing row — a ghost trigger reading the level, a menu of levels with one-line descriptions and a check on the current one, an optional destructive Remove access, and a read-only text mode for built-in rows.

meta.whenToUse: Choose or show the access level of one person, team or group on a sharing or membership row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form field choosing a value (Select), or a row's general actions (DropdownMenu or RowActionMenu).

items.name: responsive-dialog
items.title: Responsive Dialog
items.description: One overlay API that is a centred Dialog from 768px up and a bottom Sheet with a drag handle and a safe-area footer below it — the same header, body and footer in both.

meta.whenToUse: A dialog that must also work on a phone: share, members, move, create flows.
meta.whenNotToUse: A desktop-only modal (Dialog) or a side panel (Sheet).

items.name: space-picker
items.title: Space Picker
items.description: SpaceChip — a space as a quiet property chip (tile, name, chevron) — and SpacePicker, that chip opening a searchable list of spaces with My space first, a check on the current one and disabled rows that say why.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing or showing which space a record lives in, in a create dialog title or a property row.
meta.whenNotToUse: Choosing anything that is not a space (SearchableSelect, Combobox).

items.name: info-hint
items.title: Info Hint
items.description: A small muted info button beside a heading or label that opens a popover with one sentence of explanation and an optional link that opens in a new tab.

meta.whenToUse: One sentence that explains a heading, label or setting on demand — on click, tap or keyboard — with an optional link to the full help article.
meta.whenNotToUse: Naming an icon-only control (Tooltip), text people must read to complete a task (FieldDescription or inline copy), or rich content and actions (Popover or HoverCard).

items.name: choice-card
items.title: Choice Card
items.description: A radio option drawn as a card — icon, title, description and the radio — in a group that is two across from @sm and stacked below. A thin wrapper over the Field choice-card pattern.

meta.whenToUse: Two to four mutually exclusive options that each need a sentence, such as Open / Private access.
meta.whenNotToUse: Many options or short labels (RadioGroup, Select, ToggleGroup).

items.name: person-avatar
items.title: Person Avatar
items.description: A person's avatar — the photo, else initials on their hue, else initials on the muted fallback — the one way every people surface draws a person.

meta.whenToUse: Any avatar that stands for a person: rows, chips, cards, menus, comments and the user menu.
meta.whenNotToUse: An organisation or record image (Thumbnail), a space (IconGlyph), or a non-person avatar composition (Avatar).

items.name: record-aside
items.title: Record Aside
items.description: The cards of a record's details — titled sections of inline properties, people, linked records and full-width action rows.

meta.whenToUse: A record's details (the record page's Details panel, a peek, or a sheet): a Details section of inline properties, people and linked records, then sections of full-width rows for the record's tasks and suggestions.
meta.whenNotToUse: A full list page (DataList) or a settings form (Field).

items.name: record-header
items.title: Record Header
items.description: The head of any record on its page or in a peek — where it lives, its key, icon and title renamed in place, status, meta line, chips, presence and actions.

meta.whenToUse: The top of every record page and every record peek: task, meeting, row, page, customer, project.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list page header with tabs and a primary action (PageHeader), or a section title inside a record (SectionHeading).

items.name: provider
items.title: Provider
items.description: The single app-root wrapper — theme (next-themes), Base UI toasts, tooltip delays, and text direction in one mount-once component.

meta.whenToUse: Once, around your app root (layout.tsx) — every VegaStack component below it gets dark mode, working toast() calls, shared tooltip delays, and direction context.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anywhere below the root, or a second time — the bundled Toaster is a mount-once portal; pass toaster={false} if you must render your own.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually-exclusive options — single selection, arrow-key navigation, and a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2). Built on Base UI Radio Group.

meta.whenToUse: A form value from 2–5 mutually-exclusive choices, all visible at once.
meta.whenNotToUse: An immediate view or scope switch over the same content (ToggleGroup), many options (Select), or non-exclusive multi-select (Checkboxes).

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Dates & Times
items.description: One Intl-based dates & times module — formatRelative, formatDuration, formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDateRange, formatTimeOfDay, formatDueLabel, groupByDay, time-zone cookie + provider — and the RelativeTime, DateTime, Duration and DueLabel components with absolute-time tooltips.

meta.whenToUse: Any date, time, duration, due label or day grouping shown in UI — pick the function per the Dates & times page's where-to-use table.
meta.whenNotToUse: API/JSON output — keep ISO strings there.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Draggable, keyboard-resizable split panes — horizontal or vertical, nestable, with an optional collapsible panel. Built on react-resizable-panels.

meta.whenToUse: User-adjustable split layouts — code editor panes, sidebar + content, inspector panels.
meta.whenNotToUse: Fixed layouts, or layouts that only need to collapse/expand (Collapsible) without a drag/resize affordance.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with custom, auto-hiding scrollbars — dual-axis, token-styled, built on Base UI ScrollArea.

meta.whenToUse: Bounded panels whose content overflows — sidebars, log viewers, modal bodies, chat histories.
meta.whenNotToUse: Whole-page scrolling, or content that already fits.

items.name: searchable-select
items.title: Searchable Select
items.description: The Select-shaped Combobox preset: a full-width trigger, an in-panel search field, a tick on the selected row (matched by key, so async options tick too), a standard person option (name plus muted email, both searched) and an optional clear control. Single or multiple, controlled through value/onValueChange.

meta.whenToUse: A Select-shaped searchable picker: one or several values, option descriptions and disabled reasons, and server search with paging (remote + useAsyncSearch).
meta.whenNotToUse: A short fixed option set (Select), free text with suggestions (Combobox directly), or multi-select (Combobox with chips).

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle, composed from InputGroup, forwarding every native input prop and the ref to the inner input.

meta.whenToUse: Any secret the user types — sign-in, sign-up, or a change-password form — where they may need to reveal what they typed.
meta.whenNotToUse: A one-time code (use InputOTP) or a non-secret text field.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A token-safe search field with a consistent clear action, controlled and uncontrolled value handling, and native form semantics.

meta.whenToUse: A reusable search field with a consistent token-colored clear action, and a settled (debounced, Enter-flushed) value for sending the query.
meta.whenNotToUse: A general text field without search semantics, or a command palette with result navigation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown for choosing one option — trigger with value and chevron, grouped scrollable popup, item-aligned positioning, and full keyboard navigation.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing from a short fixed, known set — statuses, sort orders, units — including grouped options; pass multiple for a multi-value select. The default trigger fills its parent; use variant="ghost" (with size="sm") for an inline trigger in table rows, list items and toolbars. A two-line option composes ItemTitle + ItemDescription, and the description is the option's accessible description.
meta.whenNotToUse: Boolean on/off (Switch), few inline options (radios), a list long enough to need a search field (SearchableSelect), or free-text/async search (Combobox).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule dividing content — horizontal or vertical, built on Base UI.

meta.whenToUse: Divide distinct sections of content, menus, or toolbars.
meta.whenNotToUse: Pure spacing between elements — use margin/gap.

items.name: settings-row
items.title: Settings Row
items.description: A borders-only settings layout — titled sections, bordered cards, label-plus-control rows whose controls share one width and right edge (controlSize), and a settings × channels switch matrix with its column names once.

meta.whenToUse: Settings/preferences screens — titled sections, bordered cards, label/description + control rows, and a rows × channels matrix (Push / Email) of switches.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form content surfaces (Card), data tables, or complex multi-field forms.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge — Dialog semantics with a side, a header and a footer; opens onto the first field, never the close ×.

meta.whenToUse: Secondary content beside the page — filters, details, a settings panel, a long record form — that should not take the centre of the screen. Side sheets take size sm/default/lg/xl (Dialog's width scale); put long content in SheetBody so the footer stays on screen.
meta.whenNotToUse: A decision (AlertDialog), a centred form (Dialog), or a touch-first panel with snap points (Drawer).

items.name: shortcut-overlay
items.title: Shortcut Overlay
items.description: The ?-triggered dialog listing keyboard shortcuts, rendered from a declaration registry (keys, label, category, when) — grouped, filterable, platform-aware via use-platform + Kbd.

meta.whenToUse: Any app with keyboard shortcuts — declare each binding once (keys, label, category) and get the ?-dialog for free; the same data can feed tooltips and Command rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Inline shortcut hints (Kbd in a Tooltip, CommandShortcut) or executing bindings — the app's key handler owns dispatch.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that reserves layout space while content loads.

meta.whenToUse: Reserve layout space while content loads to avoid layout shift.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indeterminate progress with no known layout (Spinner) or determinate tasks (progress bar).

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or a range from a continuous track — horizontal or vertical, any number of thumbs, each with a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2).

meta.whenToUse: An imprecise value over a bounded range — volume, brightness, a price filter.
meta.whenNotToUse: Exact values or large/open ranges (number input); on/off (Switch).

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: Reorderable rows or tiles on ItemGroup/Item via use-drag-reorder — pointer drag with drop indicators, touch long-press, keyboard move mode, a remove button or a row menu, locked rows, a grid layout with bare tiles for attachments, and server-refusable moves. Controlled; the host owns the order.

meta.whenToUse: User-orderable single lists and tile grids — settings sections, pipeline stages, attribute values with locked built-ins, editable rows with inline actions, ordered product photos and attachments — where the host persists (and may refuse) the order.
meta.whenNotToUse: Cross-container card movement (board), selectable data tables (DataList — never mix selection with reordering), or read-only lists (ItemGroup).

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator that inherits its host's ink.

meta.whenToUse: Signal an indeterminate, in-progress load — inside a button or a loading region.
meta.whenNotToUse: Showing measurable progress (progress bar) or a skeleton-able layout (skeleton).

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A labelled value block — muted label over a value, honest faint empty state, optional delta line. Two scales.

meta.whenToUse: Record highlights and dashboard stat tiles where a value needs a quiet label.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular data (Table/DataList).

items.name: kpi-card
items.title: KPI Card
items.description: A dashboard KPI tile — a large Stat in Card chrome with an optional hint, delta line, sparkline and whole-tile link — plus KpiGrid, the grid of tiles sized by its container width.

meta.whenToUse: A row of headline numbers at the top of a dashboard or report, each with its own trend, change and optional link to the list behind it.
meta.whenNotToUse: A compact strip of counts on a home page (StatGroup), the facts of one record (Stat or PropertyList), or a full chart (Chart).

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Counts over two dimensions (weekday × hour, agent × day) as a keyboard-navigable grid of cells in five quintile steps of the single-series chart ink, with row and column headers, a tooltip per cell and an optional legend.

meta.whenToUse: Showing when or where activity concentrates across two dimensions — runs by weekday and hour, events by agent and day.
meta.whenNotToUse: A trend over one dimension (Chart), exact values people compare or sort (Table or DataList), or more than a few hundred cells.

items.name: priority-icon
items.title: Priority Icon
items.description: A flag marking priority — urgent, high, medium, low, none — each in a semantic color with filled, outline or dashed fill.

meta.whenToUse: Show a task or item's priority in rows, cards and pickers — beside StatusIcon.
meta.whenNotToUse: Status (StatusIcon) or a severity message (Alert, Badge).

items.name: status-icon
items.title: Status Icon
items.description: A small workflow status icon in Linear's set — backlog, todo, in progress, in review, done, canceled, duplicate, triage — each a hand-drawn 16-unit glyph in a semantic color.

meta.whenToUse: Indicate the workflow state of a task or issue — backlog, todo, in progress, in review, done, canceled, duplicate, triage — alongside a label.
meta.whenNotToUse: Measurable progress (Progress), generic loading (Spinner), or priority (PriorityIcon).

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A bounded linear process as an ordered list — seven step states on a numbered rail that fills in behind you, aria-current=step, orientation chosen from the step count, and a compact summary below a container width.

meta.whenToUse: Any bounded linear process — onboarding, wizards, checkout, import flows — where progress, a failed or skipped step, and a step being checked must all be communicated.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free navigation between peer views (Tabs), or the reason a flow cannot advance — that belongs beside the control it blocks, not in the rail.

items.name: multi-step-form
items.title: Multi-Step Form
items.description: A guarded, branching flow around a Stepper — conditional steps, sync and async advance guards, locking, reachability-derived deep links and resume, a panel layout for dialogs, an unsaved-work exit guard, and a phone layout chosen from the same predicate. Owns no fields and no validator.

meta.whenToUse: A process a person drives across several screens — signup, checkout, an import wizard, a multi-section record editor — where steps can branch, an advance can be refused, and a committed step must not be walked back into.
meta.whenNotToUse: Progress the system drives and a person only reads (Stepper alone), free navigation between peer views (Tabs), or one question at a time (Questionnaire).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle for instant, self-saving binary settings — two sizes and a 24px invisible hit area (A11Y-2). Built on Base UI Switch.

meta.whenToUse: Settings that apply instantly — notifications, dark mode, feature flags.
meta.whenNotToUse: Inside a form needing a Submit step — use a Checkbox.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled semantic table primitives — a scrollable container plus header, body, footer, row, head, cell, caption.

meta.whenToUse: Display tabular data with header/body/footer rows — lists, comparisons, summaries.
meta.whenNotToUse: Page layout or non-tabular content — use a grid/flex layout.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Layered content sections — default (segmented) or line variants, compact size, optional leading icons and counts, horizontal or vertical, full keyboard navigation. Toolbar switches use default Tabs for scope (My tasks | Team tasks); a list's List/Board/Grid switch is ListToolbar's Layout tool. The one component that keeps a focus ring.

meta.whenToUse: Organize related content into peer sections the user switches between in place; a count after a trigger's label is an aria-hidden tabular number plus an sr-only suffix, so it reads as part of the tab's name. A line list scrolls sideways inside itself when the tabs outnumber the width; orientation="vertical" suits a stable column of settings sections. For tabs that are separate pages, draw a nav of links from tabsListVariants and tabsTriggerVariants with aria-current="page" (route tabs).
meta.whenNotToUse: Sequential multi-step flows (stepper), single-select form input (radio/select), sections that must be visible at once, or page-level navigation rendered as a tablist — route tabs are links, not tabs.

items.name: tag-group
items.title: Tag Group
items.description: Hue-tinted label chips on the 10-hue tag palette, with +N overflow collapsing and removable tags.

meta.whenToUse: Decorative record labels/categories in rows that may overflow — the label voice.
meta.whenNotToUse: Status signals (Badge) or interactive filters (Combobox chips).

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A dark mono command block with a phosphor prompt glyph and a composed copy button.

meta.whenToUse: Install snippets and short, copyable command sequences on a marketing surface.
meta.whenNotToUse: Long-form code samples — use a standard code block.

items.name: template-editor
items.title: Template Editor
items.description: A plain-paragraph editor for text with placeholders: typing @ or {{ opens a searchable list of tokens, the one picked becomes an atomic inline chip, and the value is plain text with {{id}} tokens.

meta.whenToUse: Marketing or description text built from spec placeholders ("Recessed @Power downlight with @Efficacy…"), stored as {{id}} tokens a renderer fills in.
meta.whenNotToUse: Formatted rich text (TextEdit), plain text with no placeholders (Textarea), or a single-line value (Input).

items.name: text-edit
items.title: Text Edit
items.description: A Tiptap markdown-first rich-text editor in the shared prose typography — a slash menu and a bubble menu instead of a toolbar, a link popover, task lists, tables, code blocks, callouts and toggles, @ mentions, image and file uploads, a heading outline, comment highlights, markdown input rules and paste, and one onCommit path.

meta.whenToUse: Comments, notes, summaries and documents stored as Markdown (format="markdown") or HTML — with @ mentions, uploads, callouts, toggles, an outline and comment highlights for page editors; in-place editing of a MarkdownView (the read view is the editor until first edited).
meta.whenNotToUse: Plain single-line input (Input) or collaborative real-time docs (deferred text-edit-collab).

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A styled native textarea for multi-line text — auto-sizing to its content, invalid and disabled chrome, and the background focus tint with a border that never moves (FOC-14).

meta.whenToUse: Multi-line free text — descriptions, comments, messages, notes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-line entry (input), rich text (editor), or fixed options (select).

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief, non-blocking notifications — a stacking Base UI Toast surface with typed icons, actions and promise toasts.

meta.whenToUse: Brief confirmations of an action — 'Saved', 'Copied', 'Invitation sent' — and the loading → success/error arc of an async one.
meta.whenNotToUse: Errors the user must resolve, destructive confirmations, or essential info — use inline copy or a Dialog.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be pressed on or off, with a loading state (API-5).

meta.whenToUse: A binary on/off control that persists — bold/italic, mute, pin.
meta.whenNotToUse: One-shot action (Button) or mutually-exclusive options (ToggleGroup/RadioGroup).

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle buttons sharing one selection — single or multiple, horizontal or vertical.

meta.whenToUse: An immediate view or scope switch over the same content (Mine | Team, Grid | List) — pass deselectable={false} so one item always stays pressed — or related toggle buttons such as formatting; wrap lets a long option set fall onto rows on a narrow screen.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form value (RadioGroup), swapping page regions (Tabs), moving between URLs (links), or a single on/off control (Toggle/Switch).

items.name: tool-call-chip
items.title: Tool Call Chip
items.description: An agent-activity chip — tool action label + muted result meta, optionally rendered as a button.

meta.whenToUse: Tool invocations in an agent/chat transcript (searched, executed, created).
meta.whenNotToUse: Status badges (Badge) or long-running task rows (Marker + Spinner).

items.name: cited-list
items.title: Cited List
items.description: An answer as numbered points, each a sentence followed by its sources as small muted chips — links by default, or any element through render (a router link, a play-from-here button).

meta.whenToUse: An AI or search answer whose points each cite where they came from: a summary, an Ask answer, a list of findings.
meta.whenNotToUse: A mention or file link inside running text (InlineChip), a tool invocation in a transcript (ToolCallChip), or a plain numbered list with no sources.

items.name: suggestion-card
items.title: Suggestion Card
items.description: An agent offers one person a next step, in a card only they see: items with optional ticks, the host's own buttons, a menu, a footnote, its outcomes and a compact row.

meta.whenToUse: An agent offering a next step the person may ignore: tasks from a chat, a draft, a follow-up.
meta.whenNotToUse: A risky action that waits for a decision (RequestCard), or a change already made (AgentEditBanner).

items.name: memory-note
items.title: Memory Note
items.description: One quiet row under a chat message saying what an agent remembered, updated, suggested or forgot in a memory notebook, with Undo, Edit, Why? and a filled Keep for suggestions, and its settled outcomes.

meta.whenToUse: Show what an agent did with memory under the message that did it, or list memory outcomes (Needs you, Learned this week) with compact.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent asking to act (RequestCard) or offering a next step that is not a memory line (SuggestionCard).

items.name: effect-pill
items.title: Effect Pill
items.description: What one step of an agent's plan does, in one word and an icon: read, draft, change, send, remove or spend, hued by reach.

meta.whenToUse: Label a plan step or a pending action by its effect, in a PlanCard or a task list.
meta.whenNotToUse: A status (Badge), or a choice the person makes (ComposerChip).

items.name: composer-chip
items.title: Composer Chip
items.description: A small round chip for the chat composer's toolbar: a mode toggle such as Plan, a picker trigger such as the model, or the same words shown read-only.

meta.whenToUse: A mode or a choice in ChatComposer: the Plan toggle at the end of its context strip (ChatComposerHeader), a picker's trigger, or a choice shown read-only.
meta.whenNotToUse: Something that travels with the message (the composer's chips), or a filter in a toolbar (Toggle, Segmented).

items.name: context-ring
items.title: Context Ring
items.description: How full a chat's working memory is: a still 10px ring and its share in the composer's actions row, primary from 75%, the warning ink from 90%, opening its ContextPanel on hover, focus or click.

meta.whenToUse: Show how much of a chat's working window the last request used, in ChatComposerActionsEnd beside the model.
meta.whenNotToUse: Upload or task progress (Progress, UploadPanel), or money and run cost (RunUsage).

items.name: text-spinner
items.title: Text Spinner
items.description: The one inline text loader: a dot-matrix bolt as tall as capital letters, Strike while working and Pulse while waiting, CSS only, a still bolt under reduced motion.

meta.whenToUse: The one moving thing on a chat turn's live line, Send while it sends, or dots before the first event ("·· Thinking", "·· Reconnecting").
meta.whenNotToUse: Page or section loading (Spinner), a running task-list or Subagent row (StatusGlyph running, drawn still), or progress with a known amount (Progress).

items.name: status-glyph
items.title: Status Glyph
items.description: One glyph per state in agent UI: ✓ done in the blue accent, ◌ not started, ◐ running (still), ⊘ skipped, ✗ failed, ⚠ needs you — never green, never a fill.

meta.whenToUse: The state of a chat step, task, Subagent, request or upload, in a row or a meta line.
meta.whenNotToUse: Workflow status of a record (StatusIcon), a live loop (TextSpinner), or a pass/fail result outside agent UI (Badge).

items.name: chat-card
items.title: Chat Card
items.description: The chat's one card surface and its parts: ChatCard for what a person acts on or opens, ChatRow for one line of work, ChatGroup for a fold of work that opens and closes smoothly.

meta.whenToUse: A waiting request, question or plan, the task list or a file preview (ChatCard); a line of work with its verb, subject, meta and duration (ChatRow); a fold of work behind one summary line (ChatGroup).
meta.whenNotToUse: Settled work, memory saves, answered asks and errors, which are flat lines in the column; a record or settings card outside a chat (Card).

items.name: chat-message-parts
items.title: Chat Message Parts
items.description: One agent turn drawn straight from its AI SDK UIMessage parts: the task list, one live line (or its settled sentence) over the work log, the Subagents block, the answer never folded, files and the app's cards for data parts. Summary, Normal and Verbose reader settings; at most one spinner per message.

meta.whenToUse: Rendering an agent's UIMessage in a chat thread.
meta.whenNotToUse: The person's own messages (UserBubble); non-agent chats (Message, Bubble).

items.name: resource-pill
items.title: Resource Pill
items.description: The person's own thing an agent touched — a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck, a Drive file, a Meet, a calendar event, a GitHub pull request or issue, a Slack message, an email — as an inline chip with its type's icon and real title, opening it; never a numbered source.

meta.whenToUse: A Doc, Meet, Drive file, Slack message, pull request or other thing of the person's that a connector tool returned or made, named in an answer.
meta.whenNotToUse: A web page the answer cites (SourceList), a workspace record or person mentioned by id (InlineChip), or a file the agent made (FilePreview).

items.name: source-list
items.title: Source List
items.description: The web pages an answer cites, numbered as its [[n]] markers: "Sources · 3 ›" with the first sites' icons, opening to one-line rows (number, site icon on a light tile in dark, title, site, ↗); SourceCard is the card a [[n]] pill opens, and sourceCitations wires the list into MarkdownView.

meta.whenToUse: Web search results an agent's answer cites, under the answer, and the cards its [[n]] pills open.
meta.whenNotToUse: The person's own things such as a Doc, a Meet or a pull request (ResourcePill), records cited by a summary (CitedList), or search results the agent looked at but didn't cite (the work log).

items.name: file-preview
items.title: File Preview
items.description: A file in a chat answer, previewed on the chat card: its type icon, name and size or pages with Download and Open; Markdown rendered with its formatting (the first dozen lines, fading out), a CSV's first five rows, a PDF's first page, an image; a click opens the viewer, and a failed preview says why with Retry.

meta.whenToUse: A file an agent made or a person attached, shown in the chat where it appeared.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list of a record's files (FileCard), a file named inside running text (InlineChip's file chip), or a file being uploaded (UploadCard).

items.name: chat-details
items.title: Chat Details
items.description: The chat details panel beside the thread: quiet sections (Context, Outputs, Subagents and background work, Connectors) of icon, name and meta rows with Show more, and a back header for a Subagent's steps.

meta.whenToUse: The details rail beside an agent chat (≥1280px) or its phone sheet.
meta.whenNotToUse: Record detail asides (RecordAside).

items.name: chat-skeleton
items.title: Chat Skeleton
items.description: A chat thread while it loads in the shapes it will take (ChatSkeleton), and ScrollToLatest, the round ↓ back to the latest message with a new-words dot.

meta.whenToUse: Loading a chat thread; returning a scrolled-up reader to the latest message.
meta.whenNotToUse: Page-level loading (Spinner).

items.name: chat-user-bubble
items.title: Chat User Bubble
items.description: The person's own chat message: Markdown rendered, images as thumbnails above it, clipped at about nine lines with a soft fade into Show more, Copy and Edit on hover.

meta.whenToUse: A message the person sent in an agent chat.
meta.whenNotToUse: Agent replies, which are never clipped (MessageParts).

items.name: chat-task-list
items.title: Chat Task List
items.description: An agent's task list as the turn's progress (task list v2): a hairline box with a count-and-time header, ✓ ◐ ◌ ⊘ rows with reasons inside the row, folding on the chat motion. Data is the chat contract's data-tasklist payload.

meta.whenToUse: The data-tasklist part of an agent turn.
meta.whenNotToUse: A to-do list a person edits (Checkbox lists, Tasks).

items.name: chat-subagents
items.title: Chat Subagents
items.description: A turn's Subagents as one block whose rows open beside the chat (status word, title, quiet meta, waiting on you, Retry), and BackgroundWork in Claude Code's two weights: a chip while live, a muted line once settled.

meta.whenToUse: Subagent calls of an agent turn; background work summaries.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single tool call (WorkLog row).

items.name: chat-work-log
items.title: Chat Work Log
items.description: A turn's work read as sentences: LiveLine (the turn's one moving thing — bolt spinner, words, timer, the stuck line), WorkSummary (the settled sentence in the same 28px), WorkLog (muted verb, subject, meta rows and muted thinking notes), ErrorRow and StuckRow, and ChatClock.

meta.whenToUse: The work line and log of an agent turn drawn from AI SDK parts; a turn-level error or stuck row.
meta.whenNotToUse: Answers (MarkdownView) or cards a person acts on (ChatCard).

items.name: chat-chip
items.title: Chat Chip
items.description: A compact pill for background work and counts — "7 background commands done, 3 running ›" — on the chat card surface, with an attention tone that never adds a status fill.

meta.whenToUse: Live or partly failed background work, Subagents running, or a count that opens a panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Settled work (a muted line), a person's own things such as a Doc or a PR (a resource pill), or a filter or tag (Chip).

items.name: memory-group
items.title: Memory Group
items.description: What an agent remembered in one turn, as one quiet fold — Remembered 3 things · Personal memory — with Undo and Edit per note.

meta.whenToUse: Notes an agent saved to memory during a chat turn.
meta.whenNotToUse: A memory notebook page or a single note card outside a chat.

items.name: chat-question-card
items.title: Chat Question Card
items.description: The agent's questions drawn whole — a pager, a close, the question as the title, full-width options with muted descriptions and no radios, Other, and a Next → / Submit pill — with number keys (QuestionCard), and the line it settles into (QuestionLine).

meta.whenToUse: An agent asking the person to choose between options in a chat.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form a person fills in on a page (Field, RadioGroup); a yes/no permission (ChatRequestCard).

items.name: chat-plan-card
items.title: Chat Plan Card
items.description: A plan an agent wants approved, as a document inside the turn — steps, Will change, Won't, Needs your OK and what changed since the last version (ChatPlanCard) — and the line it settles into (PlanLine).

meta.whenToUse: A plan waiting for a person's approval in an agent chat, and its approved, rejected or replaced line.
meta.whenNotToUse: The task list a running plan becomes (TaskList); a static checklist in a document.

items.name: chat-request-card
items.title: Chat Request Card
items.description: An agent asking a person's OK, drawn from the server's stored offer: ChatRequestCard (Allow once, Always allow ▾ with its scopes, Decline with a note), RequestBundleCard for several asks at once, and RequestLine for a settled ask.

meta.whenToUse: A permission request waiting in an agent chat (ChatRequestCard), Subagents asking together (RequestBundleCard), an answered or refused ask in the turn's log (RequestLine).
meta.whenNotToUse: A list of saved permissions in settings; a general confirmation dialog (AlertDialog).

items.name: chat-menu
items.title: Chat Menu
items.description: A menu with the chat's density: one column of tight rows, a blue ✓ and a number shortcut sharing the right slot, submenus that open on hover or →.

meta.whenToUse: Picking a model, an effort level or a scope from a chat's composer or header.
meta.whenNotToUse: A general actions menu (DropdownMenu), a searchable list (Combobox), or a long setting form (Select).

items.name: plan-card
items.title: Plan Card
items.description: An agent's plan before it acts: goal, numbered steps with effects and what they touch, assumptions, what it won't do, what it will ask, risk, and Accept, Accept and allow these in this chat, Request changes or Reject.

meta.whenToUse: An agent in plan mode proposes a plan and waits for the person's answer.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single action to allow (RequestCard), or a live checklist of work in progress (TaskList).

items.name: task-list
items.title: Task List
items.description: An agent's live checklist for a longer job: the live item on top, the next two, finished items folded into a count and the rest into +N more, a waiting badge, Subagent progress, and a sticky progress bar.

meta.whenToUse: Show the agent's own checklist above its answer while a job of three or more steps runs, and its end state (done or stopped).
meta.whenNotToUse: What the agent did step by step (MessageActivity), a short static checklist (MessagePlan), or a plan waiting for approval (PlanCard).

items.name: run-usage
items.title: Run Usage
items.description: What one agent run used: a chip under the answer (steps, context, cache, optional money), a panel by model with cache per step and Subagents, and a table with one row per model call.

meta.whenToUse: Show what an agent run used: the chip under an answer, the panel in a run drawer, the table of model calls for maintainers and admins.
meta.whenNotToUse: Workspace-wide spend over time (a chart) or a single context gauge in the composer (ContextRing).

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: The box a person talks to an agent in, as a compound: an optional context strip (who it's talking to, Plan), files above an auto-growing text, and an actions row with round + and @ buttons, the model, and a round Send that morphs into Stop.

meta.whenToUse: Talking to an agent: a chat side panel, an agent's page, a full chat, a desktop quick ask. Put the model and the memory ring in ChatComposerActionsEnd and Plan in ChatComposerHeader.
meta.whenNotToUse: A comment or a reply on a record (CommentComposer), or a one-line prompt in a popover (Textarea in an InputGroup).

items.name: model-effort-menu
items.title: Model Effort Menu
items.description: A chat's model and effort as quiet text that opens one compact menu: models with number shortcuts, an Effort submenu with only the chosen model's levels, and More models with the ones you can't use, muted.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing the model and effort for a chat, in its composer's actions row (ChatComposerActionsEnd).
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent's default model in settings (Select or a settings form), or a list of many options that needs search (Combobox).

items.name: context-panel
items.title: Context Panel
items.description: What fills a chat's working memory, adding up to its window: share used, one segmented bar, a legend with tokens and shares, what's free, and Summarize now.

meta.whenToUse: The body of ContextRing's panel, or a Context section in a chat's side panel or a phone sheet.
meta.whenNotToUse: Run cost or usage limits (RunUsage), or upload progress (UploadPanel).

items.name: message-parts
items.title: Message Parts
items.description: What an agent's answer is made of beyond its text: steps, a plan checklist, status and notice lines, changes with Undo, a hand-off divider, sources, the disclaimer, actions and a version switch.

meta.whenToUse: An agent's turn, composed inside MessageContent: what it did, what it changed, where the answer came from.
meta.whenNotToUse: The row layout (Message), a person's message (Bubble with align end) or a single tool chip on its own (ToolCallChip).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A floating label on hover or focus, portaled inside the theme scope (OVL-13).

meta.whenToUse: Short supplementary labels on icon buttons, toolbar actions, and controls — optionally with a shortcut hint.
meta.whenNotToUse: Interactive content (links/buttons) or essential information — a tooltip isn't reliably reachable; use a Popover.

items.name: truncated-text
items.title: Truncated Text
items.description: Truncate text to one line or N lines with an ellipsis, revealing the full text in a tooltip only when it overflows — with per-region control over the tab stop.

meta.whenToUse: Long values in constrained layouts — table cells, nav labels, IDs/paths.
meta.whenNotToUse: Essential action text or content that must be fully visible.

items.name: use-announcer
items.title: useAnnouncer
items.description: The one polite live region — announce(text) plus a stable Announcer component, sequence-keyed so an identical consecutive announcement is still spoken.

meta.whenToUse: Any component that must tell a screen-reader user something happened with no focus change — a row moved, an entry was rejected, a save failed.
meta.whenNotToUse: Content that is visible on screen anyway and already announced by focus, or an assertive alert (role=alert is a separate policy).

items.name: use-async-search
items.title: useAsyncSearch
items.description: The server-search state machine for a searched, cursor-paged list — debounced query, abortable requests with stale responses dropped, cursor paging as a LoadMoreState, and errors that keep the loaded items.

meta.whenToUse: Server-side search over a list that pages by cursor: a remote SearchableSelect, a searched facet, a picker dialog, a searched DataList — debounce, races, paging and retry in one hook.
meta.whenNotToUse: Filtering items already in memory (pass them to the component and let it filter); a one-shot fetch with no query (use your data library directly).

items.name: use-drag-reorder
items.title: useDragReorder
items.description: The system's one drag engine seam — Pragmatic drag-and-drop pointer/touch mechanics plus the house keyboard move mode, live-region vocabulary, and async pending/rejected drop contract. One API for single lists and cross-container boards, and useDragInto for dragging an item into a folder.

meta.whenToUse: Any reorder-by-drag surface — sortable lists, wrapped tile grids (`columns` for row-aware ↑/↓), board cards, a future bespoke drag surface — where pointer, keyboard move mode, announcements, and server-refusable drops must all work from one API.
meta.whenNotToUse: File drag-in (use-file-drop), resizing panes (Resizable), or single-axis value dragging (Slider).

items.name: use-file-drop
items.title: useFileDrop
items.description: File acquisition (drop, browse, paste) over the sanctioned react-dropzone engine — typed rejection reasons aligned with Attachment's state prop, announcement payload, window-level missed-drop protection, and a folder mode that keeps each file's relative path.

meta.whenToUse: Any surface that acquires files — a Dropzone, a rich-text composer accepting pasted screenshots, a bespoke drop target — where drag-depth handling, accept matching, and typed rejections should be correct by construction.
meta.whenNotToUse: Rendering upload state (Attachment) or persisting uploads — acquisition ends at the File[] callback.

items.name: use-inline-edit
items.title: useInlineEdit
items.description: The click-to-edit state machine - draft, commit, cancel, focus restoration and the double-commit guard - with no opinion about what the editor or the display look like.

meta.whenToUse: Any click-to-edit surface: an inline field, a grid cell, a rename affordance - anywhere Enter commits, Escape cancels, and blur must not commit twice.
meta.whenNotToUse: A field that is always in edit mode (Input inside a Field); persistence, async status or optimistic revert, which belong to the component composing this hook.

items.name: use-list-nav
items.title: useListNav
items.description: Roving-tabindex keyboard navigation for a list or grid of focusable items — one Tab stop per collection, RTL-aware arrows, Home/End jumps scoped to the collection or the row.

meta.whenToUse: Any hand-rolled collection of focusable items that should read as ONE Tab stop with arrow-key movement — swatch grids, emoji grids, card lists, custom pickers.
meta.whenNotToUse: Base UI-owned collections (Select, Combobox, Menu, Tabs) — their primitives already own roving focus; and single controls that need no internal navigation.

items.name: use-grid-selection
items.title: useGridSelection
items.description: A spreadsheet range selection as state, kept by row id and column key: anchor and focus, select, extend, extendTo, row, column and all, and the range's bounds in the current order.

meta.whenToUse: A grid or table with spreadsheet-style cell ranges that must survive reordering, refetching and windowing — DataGrid's cells mode uses it.
meta.whenNotToUse: Row selection with checkboxes (useRowSelection in data-table-parts), or a one-dimensional list (useListNav).

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery / usePrefersReducedMotion
items.description: The system's one matchMedia subscription — useSyncExternalStore with a declared serverFallback, so SSR renders the branch the caller chose instead of a hard-coded false. usePrefersReducedMotion is the named reduced-motion reader over it.

meta.whenToUse: JavaScript genuinely has to branch on a media query — mounting a different component tree, skipping a requestAnimationFrame loop, enabling pointer drag.
meta.whenNotToUse: A purely visual responsive change: a Tailwind breakpoint or a container query does it in CSS with no hydration cost.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: SSR-safe viewport-width hook over use-media-query — reports whether the viewport is below a breakpoint (default 768px), live across resizes, with a caller-declared server fallback.

meta.whenToUse: Switching a layout between desktop and mobile treatments (e.g. Sidebar's rail vs. Sheet mode) based on real viewport width.
meta.whenNotToUse: CSS-only responsive layout — reach for a Tailwind breakpoint utility instead when no JS branching is needed.

items.name: use-modal-inert
items.title: useModalInert
items.description: Mirror Base UI's live modal-stack markers to native inert with reference-counted ownership while preserving region-level notifications.

meta.whenToUse: Inside a Base UI modal popup wrapper whose outside subtrees carry data-base-ui-inert but remain keyboard-focusable without the native inert property; region-level live notification surfaces remain exempt.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-modal or trap-focus-only popups that intentionally preserve outside pointer interaction; component consumers install it transitively rather than calling it directly.

items.name: use-overflow
items.title: useOverflow
items.description: Live overflow measurement — report whether an element is clipped on the inline axis, the block axis, or either, across resizes and content changes.

meta.whenToUse: Deciding something only when content is ACTUALLY clipped — offering a reveal affordance for truncated text, or making a scroll viewport focusable only while it can scroll.
meta.whenNotToUse: Layout CSS can express on its own (line-clamp, overflow) with no JavaScript branch hanging off the measurement.

items.name: use-platform
items.title: usePlatform
items.description: SSR-safe platform detection — { os, isTouch } from navigator.userAgentData with a navigator.platform fallback, corrected after hydration with no mismatch warning.

meta.whenToUse: Any copy or control that branches on modifier-key conventions (Kbd's os prop, shortcut hints, Command footers) or on a coarse pointer; formatShortcutKey / formatShortcut turn "mod" into ⌘ or Ctrl.
meta.whenNotToUse: Viewport-width layout switching — that is useIsMobile; and never wire it inside Kbd itself, which must stay server-safe.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: A framed video player with the same grouped custom transport controls as Audio Player — a poster, no autoplay, a "can't play" card with Download, and onSourceExpired to renew an expired signed URL.

meta.whenToUse: A single video asset that needs a branded frame plus grouped skip controls, mute, and keyboard shortcuts.
meta.whenNotToUse: Playlists, caption editing, fullscreen-first viewing, or adaptive streaming control surfaces.

items.name: shell-01
items.title: Shell 01
items.description: The shell reference — the module rail with counts and More, the Tasks column with views and a spaces tree, the top bar in its fixed order, a task list, and a task opening in a peek over the page; the phone bottom bar below 640px.

meta.whenToUse: Starting an app on the shell: copy it once, then move Shell into the root layout, feed its rail and column from your routes, and open records in a Peek.
meta.whenNotToUse: You only need the shell's parts — install the shell component and compose it yourself.

items.name: board-01
items.title: Board 01
items.description: A board page — a PageHeader over a ListToolbar and Board, with lanes named by their count, a paged Backlog, cards that link to each task with their own menu, and a No matches state.

meta.whenToUse: A tasks or pipeline page laid out as lanes — copy it once and wire the filters, card links and moves to your data.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list with many columns of data — use a DataList page instead.

items.name: issue-detail-01
items.title: Issue Detail 01
items.description: An issue page (Linear style) — status circle and a large title that edits in place, its properties, a Notion-style description, a separator, then comments, in one column.

meta.whenToUse: A task or issue page — title, properties, description and comments in one column; compose the same components in your app.
meta.whenNotToUse: A meeting or media record with tabs — use RecordLayout with Tabs.

items.name: page-editor-01
items.title: Page Editor 01
items.description: A document page (Notion style) with comments beside the text — header with save state and presence, an outline rail, TextEdit with comment highlights, a CommentMargin (or CommentPopover), and a version history sheet with VersionList and DiffView.

meta.whenToUse: A document page with inline comments and version history; compose the same components in your app.
meta.whenNotToUse: A record page with properties and a comments section — use issue-detail-01.

items.name: member-list
items.title: Member List
items.description: The people in a team, a space or a share list — an add row (picker · optional role · Add) and 36px rows (avatar · name over a muted sub line · role chip menu or text · ⋯ with Remove) that scroll after eight.

meta.whenToUse: Who is in a team or space, who an item is shared with, an invite list — add, change role, remove.
meta.whenNotToUse: A directory of many people with columns, search and filters (DataList), or one person's chip (RecordChip).

items.name: share-dialog
items.title: Share Dialog
items.description: Share one item — invite people and teams with one access level, people with access and why, the item's space access, and a view-only public link behind a Publish switch; a Dialog on wide screens, a bottom Sheet on phones.

meta.whenToUse: Share a record, page or meeting with people and teams, set its space access and publish it to the web — canManage gates access changes and canPublish the Publish tab.
meta.whenNotToUse: Manage a space's or team's members — MemberList.

items.name: share-01
items.title: Share 01
items.description: A Share dialog for one item — invite people and teams with one access level, people with access and why, general access in the item's space, and a view-only public link; a Dialog on wide screens, a bottom Sheet on phones.

meta.whenToUse: Share a record, page or meeting with people and teams, set its general access and turn a public link on or off.
meta.whenNotToUse: Manage a space's or team's members — MemberList.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login 01
items.description: A sign-in page: email and password with a field error each, a forgot-password link, and an alert after a rejected sign-in.

meta.whenToUse: Sign-in page for an app — copy it once, then wire signIn to your auth provider.
meta.whenNotToUse: Sign-up or password reset — reuse this card frame with their own fields (see the block's docs page); a tracked component to import in many places — install the components it composes instead.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Settings 01
items.description: A settings page — PageHeader over grouped SettingsRow sections, an ActionBar save bar that appears once something changed, and a confirmed delete.

meta.whenToUse: Starting a preferences, profile or workspace-settings route — copy it once and wire each row to your own state.
meta.whenNotToUse: One setting inside another page — compose settings-row directly.

items.name: settings-02
items.title: Settings 02
items.description: A settings hub — one titled section per area, each a grid of whole-tile links with one fact apiece.

meta.whenToUse: The settings landing page that links to each settings area — copy it once and point each tile at your routes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Editing settings in place — use settings-01, or compose settings-row directly.

items.name: status-pages-01
items.title: Status Pages 01
items.description: The 404, 403 and error pages — an Empty whose title is the page's h1, one way out, and the error's reference to copy.

meta.whenToUse: Your app's not-found, forbidden and error boundary pages, in the shell or standalone — copy the page each boundary file needs.
meta.whenNotToUse: An empty list or a failed section inside a page — compose Empty with the empty-state tiers instead.

items.name: email-kit
items.title: Email Kit
items.description: Server-rendered HTML email: a layout with a text wordmark, light and dark colours from the design tokens, and the footer; parts (heading, text, button, card, quote, item list); three templates — Notification, Digest and Action — and renderEmail for the HTML and plain-text parts.

meta.whenToUse: Transactional and notification email from a server — a comment, an assignment, a daily digest, an invite or a password reset — rendered with renderEmail and sent by your mail provider.
meta.whenNotToUse: Marketing newsletters with images and multi-column layouts, or an in-app notification — use the Inbox and Toast components.

items.name: review-split-01
items.title: Review Split 01
items.description: A record review page — summary and action items beside a sticky transcript, with a docked player, turning into tabs when its own container is narrow.

meta.whenToUse: A detail page that reviews a record against a long companion pane, such as a meeting with its transcript — copy it once and wire your record.
meta.whenNotToUse: A plain detail page with one column — compose ShellPage and PageHeader directly.

items.name: list-page-01
items.title: List Page 01
items.description: A list page — ListToolbar search, Status and Industry facets and Mine | Team over the same records as a table or a grid of linked tiles, with Load more and three empty tiers.

meta.whenToUse: A page that lists one kind of record — customers, products, projects — copy it once and wire the filters, paging and routes to your API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small list inside another page — compose DataList or an ItemGroup directly.

items.name: library-01
items.title: Library 01
items.description: A file library page — a resizable FolderTree pane beside the open folder's breadcrumb, header, uploads in flight and contents as a list or a grid, with the FileViewer and a Move dialog.

meta.whenToUse: A page for a team's files and pages — folders in Shared and Private, uploads, a list or grid of a folder's contents, a viewer and moves; copy it once and wire it to your storage API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A few files on a record (AttachmentGroup) or a single upload form (Dropzone).

items.name: notifications-01
items.title: Notifications 01
items.description: An Inbox sheet on the Inbox component — rail and phone-bar Inbox items with the unread count, Mark all read and ⋯, For you | Updates | Archived tabs, day groups of linked rows with avatars, unread tint and action chips, and infinite scroll.

meta.whenToUse: Your app's notification inbox, opened from the shell — copy it once and wire the rows, Mark all read and paging to your API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single transient message — use a toast; an activity history on a record — use ActivityFeed.

items.name: command-search-01
items.title: Command Search 01
items.description: A search palette on CommandSearch — one row of scope chips with More and Include archived, recents, results grouped by type, stale results dimmed while a search runs, loading, empty and error states, and ⌘↵ to open in a new tab.

meta.whenToUse: App-wide search behind ⌘K and the sidebar's Search row — copy it once and pass your search call.
meta.whenNotToUse: Filtering one list in place — use ListToolbar's search.
