items.name: use-view-transition
items.title: useViewTransition / startViewTransition
items.description: Run a React state change inside a View Transition — flushSync inside the snapshot, a plain update where the API is missing or the user asked for reduced motion, and an optional skip while one is already running.

meta.whenToUse: An in-page state change should cross-fade or morph instead of jumping — switching a view, reordering, opening a detail pane.
meta.whenNotToUse: A component's own enter/exit (use Base UI's lifecycle styles or the motion-* utilities), or anything that must animate in every browser.

items.name: request-card
items.title: Request Card
items.description: One card for every question an agent asks before it acts — Allow once · Always allow (one step wider from its menu) · Decline (with a note, or Never allow this) — its settled line in the same words on every channel, and What I've allowed with uses and Revoke.

meta.whenToUse: An agent asks before it acts (post, send, share, open a site, move many things) — in the chat, Home, Inbox, Needs you and on a record; and What I`ve allowed.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person asking for access (InboxItem actions), an agent`s questions with options (AgentQuestionForm), or confirming the viewer`s own destructive action (AlertDialog).

items.name: agent-edit-banner
items.title: Agent Edit Banner
items.description: The strip under a document's header after an agent changed it: the agent's purple bot, "Edited by Claude (via Manoj) · 3 changes · 2m ago", View changes, Undo and a dismiss — with the undoing, refused, created and read-only states and the other agents behind +N.

meta.whenToUse: Pinned under a page's header after an agent edited or created it, so people can see the change and undo it.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent asking before it acts (RequestCard), a transient result after the viewer's own action (Toast), or a page-wide notice (Alert).

items.name: agent-panel
items.title: Agent Panel
items.description: An agent on a record: identity, acting for, state with its actions, instructions, latest, reply and runs with Undo; plus slot, chip, badge, ring and hover card.

meta.whenToUse: A record (a task, a table row) that is delegated to an agent: the rail card on its page, the section in its peek, the Delegate property's value, the pill in a peek or phone facts row, and the state mark or ring in lists and boards.
meta.whenNotToUse: A strip after an agent edited a document (AgentEditBanner), an agent asking before one action with a preview (RequestCard), or choosing the agent (DelegatePopover).

items.name: agent-question-form
items.title: Agent Question Form
items.description: An agent asks one to five questions at once: options with their descriptions in view, the first recommended unless turned off, own words and a note per question, previews, steps and a review; and the read-only answers.

meta.whenToUse: An agent that needs the person's choice before it goes on: one quick pick, or a batch of questions with options, previews and own words.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent asking to perform one action (RequestCard), offering a next step the person may ignore (SuggestionCard), or a survey the host defines itself (Questionnaire).

items.name: delegate-popover
items.title: Delegate Popover
items.description: Delegate a record or rows to an agent: search agents (disabled with a reason), instructions, When finished, Connect an agent; bulk, empty and loading states.

meta.whenToUse: Delegating a task or table rows to an agent from the Delegate property, a peek pill, the D key or a bulk bar.
meta.whenNotToUse: Assigning a person (PeoplePicker), or showing an agent already on the work (AgentPanel).

items.name: help-menu
items.title: Help Menu
items.description: The Help menu behind the global bar's Help button — What's new (an unread dot), Docs, Keyboard shortcuts and Contact support, and the build version. Links render through your router's link.

meta.whenToUse: An app's one place to learn the product, behind the Help button at the end of the global bar: what changed, the docs, the shortcuts, support and the version.
meta.whenNotToUse: The account menu (profile, theme, sign out) or a page's own help hint (InfoHint).

items.name: route-tabs
items.title: Route Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose panels are pages — a named nav of links drawn as the pill tabs, one URL per tab, with counts, an optimistic current tab and a pending bar while the next page loads, a panel that dims meanwhile, and a sideways-scrolling strip that keeps the current tab in view.

meta.whenToUse: A section's sub-pages as tabs in its layout, each tab its own URL (a space's Tasks/Library/Settings, Connections).
meta.whenNotToUse: Panels that swap in place without a URL (Tabs), or the app's main navigation (Sidebar).

items.name: command-search
items.title: Command Search
items.description: The search palette's frame, results first — one row of scope chips with a More menu (and Include archived), results up to min(60dvh, 520px), an in-flight state that dims stale results under an input progress bar, Recent · Create · Places start sections, and a preview pane from 1280px.

meta.whenToUse: App-wide search behind ⌘K: scopes, results from your search call (with useAsyncSearch), recents and places when empty.
meta.whenNotToUse: A command menu of actions only (Command), or filtering one list in place (ListToolbar's search).

items.name: recent-strip
items.title: Recent Strip
items.description: One row of the records a person opened last — compact cards in a sideways strip with edge fades and roving arrow keys, a single line of chips on a phone, collapsible, with a same-shape skeleton.

meta.whenToUse: A Recent row above a list (the Library home) or Home's Jump back in: up to six records to return to, one tap away, without pushing the main list down.
meta.whenNotToUse: The main list of records (DataList), a grid of every item (DataList view="grid"), or a record's own links (RecordChip).

items.name: link-provider
items.title: Link Provider
items.description: One rule for every link: a plain click on an in-app link is the host router's navigation in the same tab, a modified click stays the browser's, another origin opens a new tab. Set once at the app root; every VegaStack link reads it.

meta.whenToUse: Once, at the app root, with the router's push and the app's origin; AppLink or useOpenLink for a link or Open button of your own.
meta.whenNotToUse: A link that must always open a new tab inside an unanswered dialog (RecordList's ↗), or a download.

items.name: tool-group
items.title: Tool Group
items.description: A run of icon tools — 28px ghost icon buttons two pixels apart, each named by its tooltip, with ⋯ as the one More.

meta.whenToUse: Icon-only tools in a top bar or a card header — Watch, Star, Comments, More.
meta.whenNotToUse: Text actions (Share, Approve) or attached segmented buttons (ButtonGroup).

items.name: shell-assistant
items.title: Shell Assistant
items.description: The compact assistant card at the page area's corner — header actions, a removable context chip, a scrolling body and a composer slot.

meta.whenToUse: The workspace assistant on record and page screens: a small chat about what the person is looking at, opened from the global bar's Ask or ⌘J.
meta.whenNotToUse: The full chat page (Agents), phones (a PeekSheet composes the card's parts), or any data fetching — the host owns the chat.
